title: Beyond Component Strength: Synergistic Integration and Adaptive Calibration in Multi-Agent RAG Systems
why_relevant: Studies multi-agent RAG reliability via ablations on adversarial and edge-case queries, focusing on abstention, ensemble verification, adaptive confidence thresholding, and inconsistent labeling artifacts—directly touching calibration/control and evaluation under unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Very small-scale study (50 queries, single setup) and limited methodological novelty; findings are preliminary.
